title: Retry status text overlaps the update action after the progress bar is hidden
reproduction: Proposed Android replay, NOT EXECUTED: enter DOWNLOAD_FAILED, VERIFICATION_FAILED, PERMISSION_REQUIRED or METADATA_EXPIRED on the update screen; inspect the status label and Retry update/Check again control at default and increased text size.
expected: The failure or permission explanation and its recovery action occupy separate visible regions; changelog starts below the occupied status/action region.
observed: Static state trace: retry makes update_button VISIBLE and downloadProgressBar GONE but keeps progressTextView populated. With header bottom H, GONE bar has zero height/margin; status starts at H+8 while centered action starts at H+16. AppCompat.Large is 22sp, exceeding their 8dp separation at default text scale. The independent changelog anchor also does not reserve status height. No rendered overlap measurement claimed.
fix: Not implemented in this read-only lane. Place status, progress and retry action in one vertical flow, or use state-aware constraints/barrier covering both status and action before changelog; regression-check all retry/install phases and enlarged text.
